source_claim: AlphaEvolve Table 1 and Section 2.1 report whole-code-file, hundreds-line, arbitrary-language, multi-component algorithm evolution, so local parity needs benchmark-backed codebase-scale evidence rather than only current-run workspace telemetry
claim_boundary: This boundary records that LibreEvolve has runtime telemetry for retained program file/line scale, generated candidate counts, multi-file and hundreds-line observations, parent-relative changed files/lines, static-file references, and threshold evidence, but does not claim realistic codebase fixtures, cross-file dependency edit evidence, arbitrary-language runner execution, build-runner contracts, long-horizon quality progress, benchmark valid/admitted/retained-rate summaries, or AlphaEvolve Table 1 code-scale parity.
